name: Shawarma
reason: Choose a measured yogurt-garlic sauce instead of an unspecified prepared toum; include oil and marinating time.
ingredients: 15 ml for marinade; 15 ml for sauce
10 ml for marinade; 5 ml for sauce
1 g for marinade; 1 g for sauce
steps: Coat the chicken with the shawarma spice, 15 ml lemon juice, 10 ml olive oil and 1 g salt. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
Mix the yogurt with crushed garlic, the remaining lemon juice, olive oil and salt to make the sauce. Keep refrigerated.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan or on a grill for 10–15 minutes, turning as needed, until cooked through. Rest briefly, then slice.
Thinly slice the onion, tomato and pickles. Toss the onion with sumac.
Warm the flatbreads. Divide the chicken, vegetables and sauce between them and roll up. Makes 2 wraps.
description: Spiced chicken wraps with vegetables, pickles and yogurt-garlic sauce.

name: Tandoori Chicken
reason: Specify boneless chicken and include the oil and finishing butter.
steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, tandoori masala, crushed garlic, grated ginger, oil and salt.
Coat the chicken with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours.
Preheat the oven to 220°C. Arrange the chicken on a lined tray and roast for 20–25 minutes, until cooked through.
Brush with the melted butter during the final 5 minutes. Divide into 2 portions. Extra rice, bread or chutney is optional and is not included in the quantities.

name: Roštilj
reason: Define the actual mixed grill as ćevapi and chicken skewers and include oil and seasonings.
ingredients: 6 g for mince; 4 g for chicken
3 g for mince; 1 g for chicken
steps: Mix the beef and pork with 6 g crushed garlic, baking soda, 3 g salt and 0.5 g pepper. Shape into small ćevapi fingers, cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Cut the chicken into chunks and coat with the oil, paprika, remaining garlic, salt and pepper. Refrigerate alongside the ćevapi.
Thread the chicken onto skewers. Grill both meats for about 15–20 minutes, turning regularly, until cooked through.
Warm the flatbreads and finely chop the onion. Divide the meats, onion, ajvar and sour cream into 4 portions.
description: Balkan-style mixed grill of ćevapi and chicken skewers with flatbread, onion, ajvar and sour cream.

name: Pašticada
reason: Include marinade and browning oil; make gnocchi an optional accompaniment instead of an unmeasured component.
steps: Make small slits in the beef and insert garlic pieces. Place in a covered non-reactive dish with the wine, chopped carrot and onion, rosemary and cloves. Refrigerate for 8 hours.
Remove and pat dry the beef, reserving all marinade and vegetables. Heat the oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef for about 10 minutes.
Add the drained vegetables and tomato paste and cook briefly. Add the reserved marinade, water, prunes, salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Cover and braise gently for 2½–3 hours, until the beef is tender. Add water if the pot becomes too dry.
Remove the beef, rosemary stems and cloves. Blend the sauce, slice the beef and return it to the sauce. Divide into 4 portions. Extra gnocchi is optional and is not included in these quantities.
description: Dalmatian-style braised beef in a wine, vegetable and prune sauce.

name: Pad Thai
reason: Include the sugar, oil and oyster sauce required by the method and specify a shrimp version.
steps: Soak the rice noodles for about 30 minutes, or according to their packet instructions, then drain.
Mix the fish sauce, tamarind, sugar, oyster sauce and 2 tablespoons water.
Heat the oil in a wok. Stir-fry the shrimp until almost cooked, push to one side and scramble the eggs in the same wok.
Add the drained noodles and sauce. Toss for 2–3 minutes, until the noodles are tender and the shrimp is cooked through. Add a little water if needed.
Fold in the bean sprouts and sliced green onion. Divide into 2 portions and top with chopped peanuts, chilli flakes and lime juice.
description: Thai-style stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, egg, tamarind sauce and peanuts.

name: Falafel
reason: Define dry chickpeas and a frying bath separately from consumed oil; include soaking and chilling time.
ingredients: frying bath; most is not consumed
steps: Soak the dried chickpeas in plenty of cold water in the refrigerator for at least 12 hours. Drain thoroughly. Do not use canned or cooked chickpeas.
Process the soaked chickpeas with the herbs, garlic, onion, cumin, coriander and salt to a fine, crumbly mixture. Do not purée.
Stir in the baking soda, cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Shape into 12 small balls.
Heat the frying oil to 180°C in a suitable deep pan. Fry in small batches for 3–4 minutes, until golden and cooked through. Drain well.
Serve 4 falafel per portion. Extra bread, salad or sauce is optional and is not included in the quantities.
description: Crisp chickpea falafel with fresh herbs, garlic, cumin and coriander.
nutritionReview: The 500 ml oil is a frying bath, not an edible amount. Nutrition requires an explicit retained-oil assumption; do not count the entire bath.

name: Schnitzel with Potato Salad

steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, about 20 minutes. Slice while warm. Toss with finely diced onion, vinegar, mustard, 15 ml oil, 2 g salt and pepper.
Pound the pork cutlets to about 5 mm thick and season with the remaining 1 g salt.
Put the flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs in separate dishes. Coat the cutlets in that order, shaking off excess. Discard unused coating that has touched raw pork.
Heat the remaining 135 ml oil in a wide pan. Shallow-fry the cutlets for 2–3 minutes on each side, until golden and cooked through. Drain well.
Serve each cutlet with half the potato salad and lemon juice.
nutritionReview: Do not count the entire frying bath or unused breading. Retained oil and coating require explicit estimates.

name: Sushi Set
reason: Define dry rice, edible fish weights and rice seasoning rather than an unspecified set.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook with the measured water according to the packet instructions, about 20 minutes.
Dissolve the sugar and salt in the rice vinegar. Fold into the hot rice and spread out to cool for about 20 minutes.
Keep the fish refrigerated until assembly. Use fish suitable for raw preparation; cut some into strips for rolls and the rest into thin slices for nigiri.
Slice the avocado. Spread part of the rice over the nori, add fish strips and avocado, roll tightly and cut into pieces.
Shape the remaining rice into small oblongs and top with the remaining fish. Divide the rolls and nigiri into 3 portions and serve promptly with the measured soy sauce, wasabi and pickled ginger.
